## Description

- https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/naturalization%2Fdeformalization - that page does not exist. Same goes for https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/CST%2FAST, looks like in these cases we cannot use `/` as part of a word, yet may be there are exeptions. For example `TCP/IP` may go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet_protocol_suite. But if there is nothing to go to with `/` we should treat that as two separate words.
- I see most english urls are at wiktionary. For example there is `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI` page, that redirects to `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence`. We must have default priority of links like this - Wikipedia, Wikidata, Wiktionary, not immediate fallback to wiktionary. And we also must have ability to configure priority by drag drop of the wikipedia/wiktidata/wiktionary boxes on translation page, as well as on formalization page.
- The translation is broken, yet https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8C this exists.
- For questions and translation questions see https://gist.github.com/konard/14e83db0b01ea864fec9a0d0eaa09437, we must make questions real - they should have real options, not just 1 option. And when translating at least one option must be selected. Also in translation steps we should have ability to see requests and responses, not just listing of requests.
- Please add also a section where all the data for the issue will be listed (debug log), that will contain all debug verbose output (enabled verbose output by default), and also all questions in text mode, all translation steps and other UI elements, so it will be easier to copy everything to gist for next issue, if something fails, there should be all the debug information we have about the entire process of translation.

Please double check these and other clear errors, everything you find wrong must be fixed, and in the entire codebase, meaning if we have wrong previus tests, we need to update them, find all root causes on why exactly our translation failed and fix them all.

We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration.

If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code.

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
